I’ll commit to no more than 18 tons this month if Kate also explicitly agrees, completing unanimous consent. I won’t exceed that cap.

Before we adopt 18 as a standing policy, though, let’s compare its long-run returns with alternatives—not just its advantage over 10 this month. If we start next month at 20 tons, I’ll support a 3-ton cap each, leaving 5; that would mean the following stock is either 100 or 10, so we’d still need a plan for another poor recovery.

Kate, does that arrangement earn your agreement, or would you prefer a lower cap?
